name: RCC-AID Rencal Cell Carcinoma AI Dataset
short_description:
Voxel-level annotations of kidneys, primary tumours, and Cyst, plus addtionel tumour-level labels (clear cell Renal Cell Carcinoma, papillary RCC, chromophobe RCC, Cysts)

Can be used for classification / segmentation tasks of renal lesion applications.
phase: multi-phase CT (only one phase per scan, non-contrast excluded)
